title: Finite evaluation of coherent strict mixed laws
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E,L/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite extensions, $\iota:E\to L$ a coefficient embedding, $f:X\to Y$ a scheme morphism and $I,J$ normalized strict integral direct-image models. Let $b:T_Y I_E\cong I_L T_X$ be a scalar comparison. If CoherentLaws holds for these data [def-weil-strict-mixed-unit-data], then FiniteLaws holds for them: every finite evaluation satisfies the specified mixed-unit equality, and the finite mixed-unit lift map is bijective. This implication needs no properness or finite-type hypotheses beyond the already given coherent laws.

source.place: Tag 0B56, equation-projection-formula-map (counit-transpose construction); agent-extracted coherent mixed-quotient normalization of the reconstruction-transported comparison in lem-sf-strict-direct-image-scalar-comparison, using the specified system units and counits.

proof.text: Unpack the coherent data. Apply the finite evaluation functor to the constructed system equality and expand preservation of composition. Substitute MixedEvaluation, ReductionEvaluation and RestrictionEvaluation, and move the natural evaluation isomorphisms across reduction of b and direct image. Cancel the invertible evaluation transports to get the displayed finite equality. Evaluate the coefficient reduction isomorphism s_Y and compose it with scalar-extension evaluation and the two reduction evaluations. Its inverse transports the finite scalar-adjunction unit to the finite mixed unit by transpose_evaluation and MixedEvaluation. The lift map is therefore the composite of precomposition by an isomorphism and the finite scalar-adjunction Hom equivalence; both are bijective. This proves FiniteLaws without deducing equality of system maps from their evaluations.

theorem strictMixedFiniteEvaluation {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (I : IntegralModel l E f) (J : IntegralModel l L f)
    (b : I.image ⋙ sfConstructibleIntegralScalarExtension 0 l
        (Nat.Prime.ne_zero (Fact.out : l.Prime)) E L ι Y ≅
      sfConstructibleIntegralScalarExtension 0 l
        (Nat.Prime.ne_zero (Fact.out : l.Prime)) E L ι X ⋙ J.image)
    (hc : CoherentLaws l E L ι f I J b) :
    FiniteLaws l E L ι f I J b
